question_en: Which NVIDIA executives set up Rule 10b5-1 stock sale plans during Q1 of fiscal 2025, and how many shares could each sell?
question_vi: Trong quý 1 năm tài chính 2025, những lãnh đạo nào của NVIDIA đã lập kế hoạch bán cổ phiếu theo Rule 10b5-1 và mỗi người được bán tối đa bao nhiêu cổ phiếu?
reference_answer: In Q1 FY2025 (quarter ended April 28, 2024), NVIDIA disclosed Rule 10b5-1 plans adopted by Debora Shoquist (EVP Operations, up to 41,140 shares), Jen-Hsun Huang (President and CEO, up to 600,000 shares), Colette M. Kress (EVP and CFO, up to 50,000 shares) and Ajay K. Puri (EVP Worldwide Field Operations, up to 100,832 shares).
evidence_quotes: • On March 4, 2024, Debora Shoquist, Executive Vice President, Operations, adopted a Rule 10b5-1 Trading Arrangement for the sale of up to 41,140 shares of our common stock through June 2, 2025.
• On March 14, 2024, Jen-Hsun Huang, President and Chief Executive Officer, adopted a Rule 10b5-1 Trading Arrangement for the sale of up to 600,000 shares of our common stock through March 31, 2025.

• On March 22, 2024, Colette M. Kress, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, adopted a Rule 10b5-1 Trading Arrangement for the sale of up to 50,000 shares of our common stock through May 15, 2025.

• On April 12, 2024, Ajay K. Puri, Executive Vice President, Worldwide Field Operations, adopted a Rule 10b5-1 Trading Arrangement for the sale of up to 100,832 shares of our common stock through July 11, 2025.

question_en: In GOOGL's 2024 10-K, what does Alphabet say it needs from users, advertisers and content providers to win in advertising?
question_vi: Trong báo cáo 10-K năm 2024, Alphabet (GOOGL) cho biết để cạnh tranh thành công mảng quảng cáo cần thu hút người dùng, nhà quảng cáo và nhà cung cấp nội dung dựa trên những yếu tố nào?
reference_answer: Alphabet says it must attract and retain users, mainly through ad relevance and the usefulness, security and availability of its products; advertisers, through its ability to generate sales leads and customers and deliver ads efficiently across channels; and content providers, through the quality of its advertiser base, its help generating ad revenue and its agreement terms.
evidence_quotes: • users, for whom other products and services are literally one click away, largely on the basis of the relevance of our advertising, as well as the general usefulness, security, and availability of our products and services;

• advertisers, primarily based on our ability to generate sales leads, and ultimately customers, and to deliver their advertisements in an efficient and effective manner across a variety of distribution channels; and
• content providers, primarily based on the quality of our advertiser base, our ability to help these partners generate revenues from advertising, and the terms of our agreements with them.

question_en: How does Microsoft restrict insider trading by its employees and executives, according to its fiscal 2024 annual report?
question_vi: Theo báo cáo thường niên năm tài chính 2024, Microsoft hạn chế giao dịch nội gián của nhân viên và lãnh đạo như thế nào?
reference_answer: Microsoft's General Insider Trading Policy bars trading Microsoft or other companies' securities while holding material nonpublic information and bars tipping others. Its Restricted Trading Window Policy limits corporate vice presidents and above and other designated employees to open trading windows, some officers need pre-approval, and Section 16 officers and directors face extra preclearance rules; the policies are filed as Exhibits 19.1–19.3.
evidence_quotes: Our General Insider Trading Policy prohibits our employees and related persons and entities from trading in securities of Microsoft and other companies while in possession of material, nonpublic information.

Our Restricted Trading Window Policy requires that certain officers of the company (corporate vice presidents and above) and other designated employees only transact in Microsoft securities during an open window period, subject to limited exceptions.
